description: The President's opening address, authored to the shape of real inaugural and state-of-the-union addresses (an opening, a story of the country, named priorities each tied to a law, a close) and written for this game's Presidents: every figure, law and priority is a slot or a required fact read from the world's records, never a number or a law in a sentence. Each sentence has a polished and a plain version for the speaker's recorded manner. No real President's words.

slots.inflation-rate: macro month, percent over the year
slots.wage-growth: macro months, percent over the year
slots.growth-rate: macro months, percent over the year
slots.jobs-added: macro months, jobs over the year
slots.about: the policy question's spoken noun phrase
slots.to: the policy question's spoken verb phrase
slots.state-name: the player's state, whose law the laws engine reads
slots.place: a state the President campaigned in
slots.name: a governor on the stage

mining.note: Authored; the shapes were calibrated by reading inaugural and state-of-the-union addresses as structure (opening, story of the country, priorities, close), not as text.
